import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kmpSearch_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧ 
  needle.size < 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

-- `Gm p s m` is the greatest `k ≤ m` (and `k ≤ |p|`) such that `p.take k` is a
-- suffix of `s`.  This is the *specification* of the KMP state.
open scoped Classical in
noncomputable def Gm (p s : List UInt8) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | m + 1 => if (m + 1 ≤ p.length ∧ p.take (m + 1) <:+ s) then m + 1 else Gm p s m

/-- The mathematical definition of the LPS ("longest proper prefix that is also a
suffix") table. -/
noncomputable def lpsSpec (p : List UInt8) (j : Nat) : Nat := Gm p (p.take j) (j - 1)

/-- The KMP "jump" loop: on a mismatch, fall back along the border chain. -/
def stepFuel (p : Array UInt8) (lps : Array Nat) : Nat → Nat → UInt8 → Nat
  | 0, _, _ => 0
  | fuel + 1, j, c =>
      if j < p.size ∧ p[j]! = c then j + 1
      else if j = 0 then 0
      else stepFuel p lps fuel lps[j]! c

/-- KMP preprocessing: `buildLps p i` holds the LPS values for indices `0 … i`. -/
def buildLps (p : Array UInt8) : Nat → Array Nat
  | 0 => #[0]
  | 1 => #[0, 0]
  | i + 2 =>
      let lps := buildLps p (i + 1)
      lps.push (stepFuel p lps (i + 2) lps[i + 1]! p[i + 1]!)

/-- KMP search loop: after `i` characters of text, the state is the matched
prefix length together with the occurrences found so far. -/
def searchState (ha p : Array UInt8) (lps : Array Nat) : Nat → Nat × Array Nat
  | 0 => (0, if p.size = 0 then #[0] else #[])
  | i + 1 =>
      let st := searchState ha p lps i
      let j := stepFuel p lps (st.1 + 1) st.1 ha[i]!
      (j, if j = p.size then st.2.push (i + 1 - p.size) else st.2)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def kmpSearch (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (_ : kmpSearch_precond haystack needle) : Array Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (searchState haystack needle (buildLps needle needle.size) haystack.size).2
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matchesAt (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  i + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ j, j < needle.size → haystack.getD (i + j) 0 = needle.getD j 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kmpSearch_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (result : Array Nat) (_ : kmpSearch_precond haystack needle) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i, i < result.size → matchesAt haystack needle (result.getD i 0)) ∧ -- Soundness
  (∀ i, matchesAt haystack needle i → ∃ k, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k 0 = i) -- Completeness
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

/-! ### Basic properties of the specification function `Gm` -/

theorem Gm_le (p s : List UInt8) (m : Nat) : Gm p s m ≤ m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [Gm]
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [Gm]
    split
    · exact le_refl _
    · omega

theorem Gm_prop (p s : List UInt8) (m : Nat) :
    Gm p s m ≤ p.length ∧ p.take (Gm p s m) <:+ s := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [Gm]
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [Gm]
    split
    · next hc => exact hc
    · exact ih

theorem Gm_max (p s : List UInt8) (m k : Nat) (h1 : k ≤ m) (h2 : k ≤ p.length)
    (h3 : p.take k <:+ s) : k ≤ Gm p s m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp only [Gm]; omega
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [Gm]
    split
    · exact h1
    · next hc =>
      refine ih ?_
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (m + 1) with hlt | hge
      · omega
      · exact absurd ⟨by omega, by rw [show m + 1 = k by omega]; exact h3⟩ hc

theorem Gm_zero (p s : List UInt8) : Gm p s 0 = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp (Gm_le p s 0)

theorem Gm_bound_ge (p s : List UInt8) (M : Nat) (hM : p.length ≤ M) :
    Gm p s M = Gm p s p.length := by
  obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := Gm_prop p s M
  obtain ⟨h2', h3'⟩ := Gm_prop p s p.length
  exact le_antisymm (Gm_max p s p.length _ h2 h2 h3)
    (Gm_max p s M _ (le_trans h2' hM) h2' h3')

theorem Gm_nil (p : List UInt8) (m : Nat) : Gm p [] m = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := Gm_prop p [] m
  have hnil : p.take (Gm p [] m) = [] := List.eq_nil_of_suffix_nil h3
  have hlen : (p.take (Gm p [] m)).length = 0 := by rw [hnil]; rfl
  rw [List.length_take] at hlen
  omega

/-! ### List lemmas -/

theorem take_suffix_take {p s : List UInt8} {a b : Nat} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ha : p.take a <:+ s) (hb : p.take b <:+ s) : p.take a <:+ p.take b := by
  refine List.suffix_of_suffix_length_le ha hb ?_
  simp only [List.length_take]
  omega

theorem take_succ_bang {p : List UInt8} {k : Nat} (h : k < p.length) :
    p.take (k + 1) = p.take k ++ [p[k]!] := by
  rw [List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h, getElem!_pos p k h]
  rfl

theorem suffix_concat_iff (a s : List UInt8) (x c : UInt8) :
    (a ++ [x]) <:+ (s ++ [c]) ↔ (a <:+ s ∧ x = c) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    rw [← List.append_assoc] at hu
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := List.append_inj' hu (by simp)
    exact ⟨⟨u, h1⟩, by simpa using h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨u, by rw [← List.append_assoc, hu]⟩

theorem suffix_take_succ {p s : List UInt8} {c : UInt8} {k : Nat} (hk : k < p.length) :
    (p.take (k + 1) <:+ s ++ [c]) ↔ (p.take k <:+ s ∧ p[k]! = c) := by
  rw [take_succ_bang hk, suffix_concat_iff]

/-! ### The border chain -/

theorem chain_lemma {p s : List UInt8} {j : Nat} (hj : p.take j <:+ s) :
    Gm p s (j - 1) = lpsSpec p j := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := Gm_prop p s (j - 1)
    have h1 := Gm_le p s (j - 1)
    exact Gm_max p (p.take j) (j - 1) _ h1 h2 (take_suffix_take (by omega) h3 hj)
  · obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := Gm_prop p (p.take j) (j - 1)
    have h1 := Gm_le p (p.take j) (j - 1)
    exact Gm_max p s (j - 1) _ h1 h2 (h3.trans hj)

theorem lpsSpec_le (p : List UInt8) (j : Nat) : lpsSpec p j ≤ j - 1 := Gm_le _ _ _

theorem lpsSpec_lt (p : List UInt8) (j : Nat) (hj : 0 < j) : lpsSpec p j < j := by
  have := lpsSpec_le p j; omega

theorem lpsSpec_zero (p : List UInt8) : lpsSpec p 0 = 0 := Gm_zero _ _

theorem lpsSpec_one (p : List UInt8) : lpsSpec p 1 = 0 := Gm_zero _ _

/-! ### Array / list bridging -/

theorem arr_get_bang (a : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) (h : i < a.size) : a[i]! = a.toList[i]! := by
  rw [getElem!_pos a i h, getElem!_pos a.toList i (by simpa using h)]
  simp

theorem arr_getD_bang (a : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) (hi : i < a.size) :
    a.getD i 0 = a.toList[i]! := by
  rw [getElem!_pos a.toList i (by simpa using hi)]
  simp [Array.getD, hi]

theorem arr_getD_nat (a : Array Nat) (i : Nat) (hi : i < a.size) : a.getD i 0 = a[i] := by
  simp [Array.getD, hi]

theorem push_get_lt (a : Array Nat) (v k : Nat) (h : k < a.size) :
    (a.push v)[k]! = a[k]! := by
  rw [getElem!_pos (a.push v) k (by simp; omega), getElem!_pos a k h]
  simp [Array.getElem_push, h]

theorem push_get_eq (a : Array Nat) (v : Nat) : (a.push v)[a.size]! = v := by
  rw [getElem!_pos (a.push v) a.size (by simp)]
  simp

/-! ### The master step lemma -/

theorem stepFuel_eq (p : Array UInt8) (lps : Array Nat) (B : Nat)
    (hlps : ∀ i, i ≤ B → lps[i]! = lpsSpec p.toList i) (c : UInt8) (s : List UInt8) :
    ∀ fuel j m, j < fuel → j ≤ B → j = Gm p.toList s m →
      stepFuel p lps fuel j c = Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1) := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero => intro j m hjf; omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro j m hjf hjB hjm
    obtain ⟨hjlen, hjsuf⟩ : j ≤ p.toList.length ∧ p.toList.take j <:+ s := by
      rw [hjm]; exact Gm_prop _ _ _
    have hjm2 : j ≤ m := by rw [hjm]; exact Gm_le _ _ _
    have hdec : ∀ k, Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1) = k + 1 →
        k < p.toList.length ∧ p.toList.take k <:+ s ∧ p.toList[k]! = c ∧ k ≤ j := by
      intro k hk
      obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := Gm_prop p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1)
      rw [hk] at h2 h3
      have hkl : k < p.toList.length := by omega
      rw [suffix_take_succ hkl] at h3
      have hkm : k ≤ m := by
        have := Gm_le p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1); omega
      exact ⟨hkl, h3.1, h3.2, by rw [hjm]; exact Gm_max _ _ _ _ hkm (le_of_lt hkl) h3.1⟩
    by_cases htest : j < p.size ∧ p[j]! = c
    · have hstep : stepFuel p lps (fuel + 1) j c = j + 1 := by
        simp only [stepFuel]
        rw [if_pos htest]
      rw [hstep]
      have hjl : j < p.toList.length := by simpa using htest.1
      have hchar : p.toList[j]! = c := by rw [← arr_get_bang p j htest.1]; exact htest.2
      have hge : j + 1 ≤ Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1) := by
        refine Gm_max _ _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) ?_
        rw [suffix_take_succ hjl]
        exact ⟨hjsuf, hchar⟩
      have hle : Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1) ≤ j + 1 := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1)) with hz | hz
        · omega
        · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1) = k + 1 :=
            ⟨_, (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hz).symm⟩
          have := (hdec k hk).2.2.2; omega
      omega
    · by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · have hstep : stepFuel p lps (fuel + 1) j c = 0 := by
          simp only [stepFuel]
          rw [if_neg htest, if_pos hj0]
        rw [hstep]
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1)) with hz | hz
        · omega
        · exfalso
          obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1) = k + 1 :=
            ⟨_, (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hz).symm⟩
          obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3, g4⟩ := hdec k hk
          have hk0 : k = j := by omega
          rw [hk0] at g1 g3
          have hkp : j < p.size := by simpa using g1
          exact htest ⟨hkp, by rw [arr_get_bang p j hkp]; exact g3⟩
      · have hstep : stepFuel p lps (fuel + 1) j c = stepFuel p lps fuel lps[j]! c := by
          simp only [stepFuel]
          rw [if_neg htest, if_neg hj0]
        rw [hstep, hlps j hjB]
        have hchain : lpsSpec p.toList j = Gm p.toList s (j - 1) := (chain_lemma hjsuf).symm
        have hlt : lpsSpec p.toList j < j := lpsSpec_lt _ _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj0)
        rw [ih (lpsSpec p.toList j) (j - 1) (by omega) (by omega) hchain]
        have hj1 : j - 1 + 1 = j := by omega
        rw [hj1]
        apply le_antisymm
        · obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := Gm_prop p.toList (s ++ [c]) j
          exact Gm_max _ _ _ _ (by have := Gm_le p.toList (s ++ [c]) j; omega) h2 h3
        · obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := Gm_prop p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1)
          refine Gm_max _ _ _ _ ?_ h2 h3
          rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1)) with hz | hz
          · omega
          · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, Gm p.toList (s ++ [c]) (m + 1) = k + 1 :=
              ⟨_, (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hz).symm⟩
            obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3, g4⟩ := hdec k hk
            have hkj : k ≠ j := by
              intro hkj
              subst hkj
              have hkp : k < p.size := by simpa using g1
              exact htest ⟨hkp, by rw [arr_get_bang p k hkp]; exact g3⟩
            omega

/-! ### Correctness of the preprocessing -/

theorem buildLps_size (p : Array UInt8) : ∀ i, (buildLps p i).size = i + 1 := by
  intro i
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ i ih =>
    match i with
    | 0 => simp [buildLps]
    | 1 => simp [buildLps]
    | (n + 2) =>
      show ((buildLps p (n + 1)).push _).size = n + 3
      rw [Array.size_push, ih (n + 1) (by omega)]

theorem buildLps_correct (p : Array UInt8) : ∀ i, i ≤ p.size → ∀ k, k ≤ i →
    (buildLps p i)[k]! = lpsSpec p.toList k := by
  intro i
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ i ih =>
    match i with
    | 0 =>
      intro _ k hk
      have : k = 0 := by omega
      subst this
      rw [lpsSpec_zero]
      show (#[0] : Array Nat)[0]! = 0
      rfl
    | 1 =>
      intro _ k hk
      interval_cases k
      · rw [lpsSpec_zero]; show (#[0, 0] : Array Nat)[0]! = 0; rfl
      · rw [lpsSpec_one]; show (#[0, 0] : Array Nat)[1]! = 0; rfl
    | (n + 2) =>
      intro hi k hk
      have hsz : (buildLps p (n + 1)).size = n + 2 := buildLps_size p (n + 1)
      have hIH : ∀ q, q ≤ n + 1 → (buildLps p (n + 1))[q]! = lpsSpec p.toList q :=
        fun q hq => ih (n + 1) (by omega) (by omega) q hq
      by_cases hk' : k ≤ n + 1
      · have hval : (buildLps p (n + 2))[k]! = (buildLps p (n + 1))[k]! := by
          show ((buildLps p (n + 1)).push _)[k]! = _
          exact push_get_lt _ _ _ (by omega)
        rw [hval]
        exact hIH k hk'
      · have hk2 : k = n + 2 := by omega
        subst hk2
        have hval : (buildLps p (n + 2))[n + 2]! =
            stepFuel p (buildLps p (n + 1)) (n + 2) (buildLps p (n + 1))[n + 1]! p[n + 1]! := by
          show ((buildLps p (n + 1)).push _)[n + 2]! = _
          rw [← hsz]
          exact push_get_eq _ _
        rw [hval, hIH (n + 1) (le_refl _)]
        have hip : n + 1 < p.size := by omega
        have hip' : n + 1 < p.toList.length := by simpa using hip
        have hjlt : lpsSpec p.toList (n + 1) < n + 2 := by
          have := lpsSpec_le p.toList (n + 1); omega
        have hjB : lpsSpec p.toList (n + 1) ≤ n + 1 := by
          have := lpsSpec_le p.toList (n + 1); omega
        have heq := stepFuel_eq p (buildLps p (n + 1)) (n + 1) hIH (p[n + 1]!)
            (p.toList.take (n + 1)) (n + 2) (lpsSpec p.toList (n + 1)) n hjlt hjB rfl
        rw [heq, arr_get_bang p (n + 1) hip, ← take_succ_bang hip']
        rfl

/-! ### Correctness of the search loop -/

theorem searchState_spec (ha p : Array UInt8) (lps : Array Nat)
    (hlps : ∀ k, k ≤ p.size → lps[k]! = lpsSpec p.toList k) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ ha.size →
      (searchState ha p lps i).1 = Gm p.toList (ha.toList.take i) p.size ∧
      (∀ q, q ∈ (searchState ha p lps i).2.toList ↔
        (q + p.size ≤ i ∧ p.toList <:+ ha.toList.take (q + p.size))) := by
  have hpl : p.toList.length = p.size := by simp
  have hpl_take : p.toList.take p.size = p.toList := by
    rw [← hpl, List.take_length]
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    constructor
    · show (0 : Nat) = _
      rw [List.take_zero, Gm_nil]
    · intro q
      by_cases hp : p.size = 0
      · have hnil : p.toList = [] := by
          apply List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero
          rw [hpl, hp]
        show q ∈ (if p.size = 0 then (#[0] : Array Nat) else #[]).toList ↔ _
        rw [if_pos hp, hp, hnil]
        simp
      · show q ∈ (if p.size = 0 then (#[0] : Array Nat) else #[]).toList ↔ _
        rw [if_neg hp]
        constructor
        · intro hm; simp at hm
        · rintro ⟨g1, -⟩
          exfalso; omega
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi
    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hik : i < ha.size := by omega
    have hik' : i < ha.toList.length := by simpa using hik
    have hd1 : (searchState ha p lps (i + 1)).1 =
        stepFuel p lps ((searchState ha p lps i).1 + 1) (searchState ha p lps i).1 ha[i]! := rfl
    have hd2 : (searchState ha p lps (i + 1)).2 =
        (if (searchState ha p lps (i + 1)).1 = p.size
         then (searchState ha p lps i).2.push (i + 1 - p.size)
         else (searchState ha p lps i).2) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [show (i + 1) = (i + 1) from rfl]
      rfl
    have hjB : (searchState ha p lps i).1 ≤ p.size := by
      rw [ih1]
      have := (Gm_prop p.toList (ha.toList.take i) p.size).1
      omega
    have htake : ha.toList.take i ++ [ha[i]!] = ha.toList.take (i + 1) := by
      rw [arr_get_bang ha i hik, take_succ_bang hik']
    have hnew : (searchState ha p lps (i + 1)).1 =
        Gm p.toList (ha.toList.take (i + 1)) p.size := by
      rw [hd1]
      rw [stepFuel_eq p lps p.size hlps (ha[i]!) (ha.toList.take i)
        ((searchState ha p lps i).1 + 1) (searchState ha p lps i).1 p.size
        (by omega) hjB ih1]
      rw [htake, Gm_bound_ge p.toList _ (p.size + 1) (by omega), hpl]
    have hlen : (ha.toList.take (i + 1)).length = i + 1 := by
      rw [List.length_take]
      omega
    have hEq : (searchState ha p lps (i + 1)).1 = p.size ↔
        (p.toList <:+ ha.toList.take (i + 1) ∧ p.size ≤ i + 1) := by
      rw [hnew]
      constructor
      · intro hg
        obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := Gm_prop p.toList (ha.toList.take (i + 1)) p.size
        rw [hg, hpl_take] at h3
        refine ⟨h3, ?_⟩
        have hll := h3.length_le
        rw [hlen, hpl] at hll
        exact hll
      · rintro ⟨hs, _⟩
        have h1 : p.size ≤ Gm p.toList (ha.toList.take (i + 1)) p.size :=
          Gm_max _ _ _ _ (le_refl _) (by omega) (by rw [hpl_take]; exact hs)
        have h2 := (Gm_prop p.toList (ha.toList.take (i + 1)) p.size).1
        omega
    refine ⟨hnew, ?_⟩
    intro q
    rw [hd2]
    by_cases hcase : (searchState ha p lps (i + 1)).1 = p.size
    · rw [if_pos hcase]
      obtain ⟨hsuf, hle⟩ := hEq.mp hcase
      rw [Array.toList_push, List.mem_append]
      simp only [List.mem_singleton]
      rw [ih2 q]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨g1, g2⟩ | rfl)
        · exact ⟨by omega, g2⟩
        · refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
          rw [show i + 1 - p.size + p.size = i + 1 by omega]
          exact hsuf
      · rintro ⟨g1, g2⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (q + p.size) (i + 1) with hlt | hge
        · exact Or.inl ⟨by omega, g2⟩
        · exact Or.inr (by omega)
    · rw [if_neg hcase, ih2 q]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨g1, g2⟩; exact ⟨by omega, g2⟩
      · rintro ⟨g1, g2⟩
        refine ⟨?_, g2⟩
        by_contra hcon
        have hq : q + p.size = i + 1 := by omega
        rw [hq] at g2
        exact hcase (hEq.mpr ⟨g2, by omega⟩)

/-! ### Relating the suffix characterisation to `matchesAt` -/

theorem occ_iff (ha p : Array UInt8) (q : Nat) :
    (q + p.size ≤ ha.size ∧ p.toList <:+ ha.toList.take (q + p.size)) ↔ matchesAt ha p q := by
  have hpl : p.toList.length = p.size := by simp
  have hal : ha.toList.length = ha.size := by simp
  unfold matchesAt
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hq, hs⟩
    refine ⟨hq, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    rw [List.take_add] at hs
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨-, h2⟩ := List.append_inj' hu (by
      rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop]
      omega)
    have hj' : j < ((ha.toList.drop q).take p.size).length := by
      rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop]; omega
    have hgj : p.toList[j]! = ((ha.toList.drop q).take p.size)[j]! := by rw [h2]
    rw [arr_getD_bang ha (q + j) (by omega), arr_getD_bang p j (by omega), hgj,
      getElem!_pos _ j hj', getElem!_pos ha.toList (q + j) (by omega)]
    simp
  · rintro ⟨hq, hpt⟩
    refine ⟨hq, ?_⟩
    rw [List.take_add]
    refine ⟨ha.toList.take q, ?_⟩
    congr 1
    apply List.ext_getElem
    · rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop]; omega
    · intro j h1 h2
      have hj : j < p.size := by omega
      have := hpt j hj
      rw [arr_getD_bang ha (q + j) (by omega), arr_getD_bang p j (by omega)] at this
      rw [getElem!_pos ha.toList (q + j) (by omega), getElem!_pos p.toList j (by omega)] at this
      simp only [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_drop]
      rw [this]

theorem final_step (ha p : Array UInt8) (res : Array Nat)
    (hres : ∀ q, q ∈ res.toList ↔ matchesAt ha p q) :
    (∀ i, i < res.size → matchesAt ha p (res.getD i 0)) ∧
    (∀ i, matchesAt ha p i → ∃ k, k < res.size ∧ res.getD k 0 = i) := by
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    apply (hres _).mp
    apply List.mem_iff_getElem.mpr
    refine ⟨i, by simpa using hi, ?_⟩
    rw [arr_getD_nat res i hi]
    simp
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkv⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp ((hres i).mpr hi)
    have hk' : k < res.size := by simpa using hk
    refine ⟨k, hk', ?_⟩
    rw [arr_getD_nat res k hk']
    simpa using hkv

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem kmpSearch_postcond_satisfied (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8)
    (h_precond : kmpSearch_precond haystack needle) :
    kmpSearch_postcond haystack needle (kmpSearch haystack needle h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hlps : ∀ k, k ≤ needle.size →
      (buildLps needle needle.size)[k]! = lpsSpec needle.toList k :=
    fun k hk => buildLps_correct needle needle.size (le_refl _) k hk
  obtain ⟨-, hmem⟩ := searchState_spec haystack needle (buildLps needle needle.size) hlps
    haystack.size (le_refl _)
  apply final_step
  intro q
  rw [show (kmpSearch haystack needle h_precond) =
    (searchState haystack needle (buildLps needle needle.size) haystack.size).2 from rfl]
  rw [hmem q, ← occ_iff]
  -- !benchmark @end proof

`LEAN VERIFIED` — the proof compiles with no `sorry`, `axiom`, `partial`, or other escapes.

## What's in `Solution.lean`

**Implementation (auxcode + code):** genuine KMP.
- `stepFuel p lps fuel j c` — the border-chain jump loop: on mismatch it falls back to `lps[j]`, otherwise advances. The `fuel` parameter (always instantiated to `j + 1`) gives structural termination; since `lps[j] < j`, the fuel is always sufficient.
- `buildLps p i` — incremental LPS preprocessing, `lps[0] = lps[1] = 0` and `lps[i+1] = stepFuel … lps[i] p[i]`.
- `searchState ha p lps i` — the search loop, carrying the matched-prefix length and the occurrences found so far; it uses the same jump logic and never rescans text.
- `kmpSearch = (searchState haystack needle (buildLps needle needle.size) haystack.size).2`.

**Proof architecture.** The pivot is a specification function `Gm p s m` = the greatest `k ≤ m` (with `k ≤ |p|`) such that `p.take k` is a suffix of `s`, defined by its own recursion so that maximality is available by construction (`Gm_le`, `Gm_prop`, `Gm_max`). Then `lpsSpec p j = Gm p (p.take j) (j-1)` is exactly the textbook LPS definition.

- **`chain_lemma`**: if `p.take j <:+ s` then `Gm p s (j-1) = lpsSpec p j`. This is the "safe skipping" fact — the lps chain enumerates precisely the candidate match lengths, so no valid match is skipped.
- **`stepFuel_eq`** (master lemma): if `j = Gm p s m`, then `stepFuel p lps fuel j c = Gm p (s ++ [c]) (m+1)`. Proved by induction on fuel, using `chain_lemma` at the fallback step.
- This single lemma discharges *both* verification challenges: instantiated at `s := p.take i, m := i-1` it yields `buildLps_correct` (the LPS table meets its mathematical definition); instantiated at `s := t.take i, m := |p|` it yields the loop invariant in `searchState_spec`, namely that the state is the longest prefix of the needle that is a suffix of the text read so far, and that the accumulator holds exactly the occurrences ending at or before position `i`.
- `occ_iff` converts the suffix characterisation to the postcondition's index-wise `matchesAt`, giving soundness and completeness.

**One practical caveat worth flagging:** `searchState` recurses once per text character and is not tail-recursive, so on inputs near the 10⁶ precondition bound it may exhaust the stack when actually executed. That affects runtime behaviour only, not the verified correctness properties; converting it to a tail-recursive/`Nat.fold` form would require redoing the invariant proof against the new recursion shape, so I left the structure that the proof is built on.
